known.summary: `parseFreeModels` skips a catalog row only when both the input price and the output price are not 0. A model with free input and paid output, or the reverse, so counts as free. `docks-kit omp` can then offer it, remember it, and run every model role on it, so a session that the user starts as free causes paid spend, which the free-session launcher exists to prevent. The pull request adds ompOverlay.ts: the base has no such file and no free-model filter.
